code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and mild eosinophilia. There is evidence of inflammation (elevated CRP, ferritin, LDH, and alkaline phosphatase). Liver and renal function, coagulation, and cardiac markers are within normal limits. Findings suggest acute or chronic inflammatory or infectious process with possible bone marrow involvement or dysregulation. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
